description.p: ydoit lets you bind GNOME keyboard shortcuts that automatically type predefined strings into the active window. It stores entries in a GPG-encrypted configuration file, syncs keybindings with GNOME, and delivers keystrokes natively on Wayland via ydotool.

ul.li: GPG encryption for all stored entries
Wayland-native keystroke delivery via ydotool or Mutter RemoteDesktop
GNOME Keyring passphrase caching via libsecret
Type arbitrary strings or file contents on demand

description.p: Public-repo hygiene release: generic committer identity; internal planning docs no longer shipped.

Selectable input backend (auto / Mutter RemoteDesktop / ydotool) for GNOME Remote Desktop sessions; escape expansion for Mutter; status shows configured vs effective backend. Built on top of the 2.1.0 ydotoold reliability fixes.
Ship user-scoped ydotoold unit, probe the daemon socket directly, auto-start on first type, surface ydotool stdout in errors.
Show version number in the main window footer and Settings.
Initial release with CLI and GTK4/libadwaita GUI.
